result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major content/layout problem with overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar entry.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar subtitle shows overlapping text where '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' appear stacked on top of each other, rendering both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the delivery time and delivery fee are properly spaced (e.g., separated by a bullet on a single line) instead of overlapping.
